text: Bounded follow-up proposal after this tranche (not implemented/accepted): implement VisualParitySuite with an explicit5perspectives x3moments(t1/t2/t3) x2themes =30state manifest. S0.4 snapshots at1x and2x imply60Linux-only golden PNGs; keep actual nativeGTK2 analytic acceptance separate from transformed snapshots. Extend/reuse ShellMomentsFxSuite story boot and BoardParityCaptureFxSuite public-input port/readiness rather than a second hand-coded fake scene. Current ShellMoments covers15light +3Compare-dark states, snapshots/text checks only; it has no full-window pixel comparator. Await served trial/map, geometry, summary and figure readiness as appropriate; CSS/layout pulses alone do not prove those asynchronous products are drawn. Make theme/focus/cursor/scroll/animation state explicit and deterministic. Generate/review baselines in the pinned Linux CI/JDK/JavaFX/font/software-renderer environment; macOS remains functional checks per S0.4. Compare JavaFX to JavaFX only; browser board references remain semantic review. Define a named discrepancy policy from repeat-capture evidence, keep failed diffs, and verify comparator rejection by deliberate changed pixels as well as missing/wrong-size baselines. Require every manifest state to bind to an executed passing XML case, so a focus-loss assumption/skip cannot yield false matrix acceptance. Baseline update must be explicit and reviewed; no CI auto-acceptance. This handoff does not close the parent or implement the independently tracked Results Participants navigator.
